description: The site's FAQ answers (hours, prices, machines, payment, ATM, WiFi, what to do when something goes wrong). Take A Load Off answers identify the separate wash-and-fold partner and link to its own site, without its prices, turnaround or phone. Returns up to five answers by default, with or without a query. The language value "es" selects the Spanish FAQ.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

limit.description: At most this many answers (default 5, maximum 10). The source page contains the full FAQ.

query.description: Nonblank words to look for, e.g. "ATM" or "king comforter"; without a query, FAQ answers are listed.

name: search_faq
